text: Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu Kushmanda Rupena Samsthita.
I repeatedly bow to the Goddess who resides in all beings in the form of Devi Kushmanda.
Praying for the fulfillment of desired wishes, I bow to the glorious Sri Kushmanda Devi, who adorns a crescent moon on her head, is seated on a lion vehicle, and appears with eight arms.
We meditate upon Adishakti, the source of creation, in the form of the Goddess who is seated on a lion vehicle with eight arms.
